from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path("udt_conservation_variational_response_2026-09-28")
launch=json.loads((p/"LAUNCH.json").read_text())
maintained={"LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md","MEMORY.md","INDEX.md","UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md"}
bad=[f for f,h in launch["pins"].items() if f not in maintained and hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h]
assert not bad,bad
freeze=json.loads((p/"CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json").read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((p/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in freeze["files"].items())
review=json.loads((p/"review/SOURCE_FIRST_PINS.json").read_text())
for group in ("sources","sealed_source_first_evidence"):
 for f,h in review[group].items():
  assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
with Path("CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv").open() as f: rows={r["premise_id"]:r for r in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t")}
selected=json.loads((p/"SCOPED_REGISTRY.json").read_text())
assert all(rows[r["premise_id"]]==r for r in selected)
current=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines())
assert set(launch["untracked_paths"])<=current
assert {x for x in current if not x.startswith(str(p)+"/")}==set(launch["untracked_paths"])
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed==maintained,changed
before=subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","show",launch["head"]+":CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md"],text=True)
now=Path("CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md").read_text()
assert before.split("## Current next gate")[0]==now.split("## Current next gate")[0]
subprocess.run(["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","diff","--check"],check=True)
size=sum(f.stat().st_size for f in p.rglob("*") if f.is_file())
assert size<10_000_000,size
print(json.dumps({"pass":True,"unchanged_source_pins":len(launch["pins"])-len(maintained),"candidate_pins":len(freeze["files"]),"source_first_pins":sum(len(review[g]) for g in ("sources","sealed_source_first_evidence")),"scoped_registry_rows":len(selected),"prior_untracked_paths":len(launch["untracked_paths"]),"maintained_files":sorted(maintained),"founding_opening_unchanged":True,"package_bytes":size}))
